_doc: Every mod this project ships, for tools/kit.py (package, deploy, check) and pr/MODDING.md.
Paths are relative to pr/. A mod is a BepInEx plugin, a Magicite data folder, or both:
name          folder name: BepInEx/plugins/<name> and Magicite/<name>
game          ff1..ff6 (the plugin is built against that game's code)
plugin        project: the plugin's folder (dotnet build -c Release); files/dirs: [source, name in the plugin folder]
magicite      the built Magicite folder; magicite_skip: file names left out of it
build         commands run from pr/ before the plugin is built (data scripts); {python} = the venv's
exclusive     mods sharing this tag are never installed together (deploy shelves the others)
keep          plugin sub-folders a reinstall leaves in place (player data, e.g. WC's seeds)
deploy        a mod's own deploy command, used instead of the generic one
version / version_file + version_key: the package's version suffix
package_leave_out  plugin-folder paths the zip leaves out (made on the player's machine from their game);
package_magicite false: the Magicite folder too; player_setup: the script the plugin
runs to make them (the packager checks the plugin's DLL names it)
readme_note   extra paragraph in the package README

bnw.name: BraveNewWorld
bnw.title: Brave New World 3.0 for FINAL FANTASY VI Pixel Remaster
bnw.readme_note:
This is a mod of its own: don't install it beside the project's other mod (Brave New World and
Worlds Collide each change the same game data). Start a new game after installing.

wc.name: WorldsCollide
wc.title: Worlds Collide 1.4.3 for FINAL FANTASY VI Pixel Remaster
wc.readme_note:
Playing: on the title screen, choose "Worlds Collide". Pick a preset or paste flags from the
website (Ctrl+V), type a seed or leave a random one, then "Generate and play this seed" and start a
New Game. Saves remember their seed. Seeds match the Worlds Collide website's for the same seed and
flags. Worlds Collide is by AtmaTek and its contributors (MIT license:
BepInEx/plugins/WorldsCollide/generator/wc/LICENSE.txt).

This is a mod of its own: don't install it beside the project's other mod (Brave New World and
Worlds Collide each change the same game data). Start a new game after installing.

hd2d.name: HD2D
hd2d.title: HD-2D look for the Pixel Remaster
hd2d.readme_note: Works beside any other mod (it only changes how the picture is drawn). Shaders: pr/hd2d/build_bundle.sh.
